225:t_016:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll submit the details as data later, but it seems overcoming the end that comes every 12,000 years isn't impossible.」

225:t_016:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Right. We've never heard of the universe ending 12,000 years ago in any parallel world.」

225:t_016:11.en:
$n
「...I'm sure I'm thinking the same thing you are, $$セツコ$$...」

225:t_016:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
(There certainly are worlds that overcame the crisis that comes every 12,000 years...)

225:t_016:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But the crisis that comes once every 120 million years engulfs all parallel worlds...)

225:t_017:0.en:
$$ラム$$
「Captain, a message from the $$バトル７$$! They're struggling against enemy reinforcements! They request immediate assistance!」

225:t_017:2.en:
$$ラム$$
「N-no...! The ones who appeared are... $$サイデリアル$$!」

225:t_018:0.en:
$$ファ$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ have broken through the defensive line!」

225:t_018:1.en:
$$エマ$$
「Hurry after them! If the ruins take any more attacks, the survey team won't survive!」

225:t_019:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「I've got $$ランカ$$ aboard...! I'll protect her, no matter what!」

225:t_019:3.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Thank you, $$アルト$$... For now, I'll just be happy about it...)

225:t_020:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Third kill confirmed. Moving to the next target.」

225:t_020:2.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Sorry, $$ランカ$$. Please bear with it a little longer.」

225:t_020:3.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But I promise. I'll protect you, no matter what.」

225:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
($$ランカ$$ is behind me...! I'll protect her, no matter what!)

225:t_100:1.en:
$$アルト$$
(My wings are here to protect them! I'll do it!)

225:t_101:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
($$ランカ$$... I'm a man who has no right to be called your brother.)

225:t_101:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(But I'll protect you at least...! Even if it costs me my life!)

225:t_102:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「That's it, $$ガムリン$$! I can feel your burning heart!」

225:t_102:1.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Me too, $$バサラ$$! Your heart sets mine on fire!」

225:t_102:3.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
(They're both fine men. You'll have a hard time choosing, $$ミレーヌ$$.)

225:t_103:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Even our talk with that $$プロトカルチャー$$ didn't resolve our unease...)

225:t_103:2.en:
$n
(The true end that comes once every 120 million years... the great collapse... But I'm sure there's more to it...)

225:t_103:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
(What awaits us there...? What are we afraid of...?)

Ray speaker resolved as Fire Bomber Ray (#pt231) by scene cast, despite ambiguous options and shifted pid.
